works.title: SSO configuration fails for Okta integration
works.body: Customer reports SAML assertion errors when setting up Okta SSO. Metadata upload completes but login loop persists.

works.title: Users locked out after MFA device reset
works.body: After resetting authenticator app, users cannot regain access without manual admin intervention.

works.title: Session expiry too aggressive for inactive tabs
works.body: Users are logged out mid-workflow when switching browser tabs, causing data loss.

works.title: Monthly invoice not delivered to billing contact
works.body: Invoice for the current period was not emailed to the designated billing address despite correct configuration.

works.title: Plan upgrade page returns 500 error
works.body: Clicking 'Upgrade to Enterprise' on the billing page throws a 500 Internal Server Error. Reproducible across browsers.

works.title: Prorated charges calculated incorrectly on mid-cycle upgrade
works.body: Customer upgraded on the 15th but was charged the full month amount rather than a prorated rate.

works.title: Webhooks silently dropping events under load
works.body: During high-throughput periods, webhook delivery fails without triggering retries. Events are lost.

works.title: Webhook signature verification failing intermittently
works.body: HMAC signature mismatch errors appearing on roughly 5% of webhook deliveries with no payload changes.

works.title: API rate limit headers missing from responses
works.body: Customers cannot implement proper backoff because X-RateLimit headers are absent from API responses.

works.title: SSO group attribute mapping not syncing roles
works.body: User groups defined in the IdP are not mapping to Lumio roles post-authentication.

works.title: Cancellation flow does not confirm downgrade date
works.body: After initiating cancellation, customers receive no confirmation of their effective end date, causing confusion.

works.title: OAuth token refresh fails for third-party apps
works.body: Refresh tokens issued to connected OAuth apps expire prematurely, forcing users to re-authenticate daily.

sla_policies.name: Lumio Enterprise SLA
sla_policies.description: Enterprise-tier SLA for Lumio customers with aggressive first-response and resolution targets.
sla_policies.escalation: Page on-call engineer if P0 first response is not met within 15 minutes. Escalate P1 to team lead after 1 hour.

plug_config.welcome_message: Hi! I'm the Lumio Support Assistant. Ask me anything about authentication, billing, or integrations.
plug_config.ai_grounding_notes: Ground AI agent on the 8 published KB articles covering SSO setup, MFA recovery, billing/invoices, plan upgrades, webhooks, API rate limits, IdP group sync, and OAuth token troubleshooting.

ui_guidance.title: SLA Policy Setup
steps: Navigate to Settings → Support → SLA Policies.
Create a new policy named 'Lumio Enterprise SLA'.
Set First Response targets: P0=30 min, P1=2 h, P2=8 h, P3=24 h.
Set Resolution targets: P0=4 h, P1=24 h, P2=72 h, P3=168 h (1 week).
Add escalation rule: page on-call if P0 first response is not met within 15 min; escalate P1 to team lead after 1 h.
Apply this policy to tickets tagged with account tier 'Enterprise'.
Reference: https://devrev.ai/docs/DevRevU/demos

ui_guidance.title: Slack Integration
steps: Navigate to Settings → Integrations → Slack.
Authorise the DevRev Slack app in your workspace.
Map a Slack channel (e.g. #lumio-support-alerts) to receive ticket notifications.
Enable bi-directional sync so Slack thread replies appear as timeline entries in DevRev.
Reference: https://developer.devrev.ai/beta/about/for-developers

ui_guidance.title: Feature Request Handler (Auto-promote tickets to enhancements)
steps: Navigate to Settings → Snap-ins → Feature Request Handler.
Install the snap-in and configure the trigger keyword (e.g. 'feature request' or 'enhancement').
Set the target part to 'Lumio Platform' or a specific capability so promoted items land in the right part of the hierarchy.
Configure the Slack notification to post to #lumio-product-feedback when a ticket is promoted.
Reference: https://devrev.ai/docs/DevRevU/demos

ui_guidance.title: PLuG Chat Widget Deployment
steps: Navigate to Settings → PLuG → Widget.
Set the welcome message: 'Hi! I'm the Lumio Support Assistant. Ask me anything about authentication, billing, or integrations.'
Set primary colour to #6C47FF.
Enable AI Agent and set fallback action to 'Create ticket'.
Under AI Grounding, select all 8 published KB articles as source material.
Copy the embed snippet and add it to the Lumio web app's <head>.
Reference: https://developer.devrev.ai/beta/about/for-developers

ui_guidance.title: Saved Views for Demo
steps: Create a 'P0 & P1 Open Tickets' view filtered by severity IN [high] AND status != closed.
Create a 'Tickets by Capability' view grouped by applies_to_part for a visual breakdown across Auth, Billing, and Integrations.
Pin both views to the left nav for fast access during the demo walkthrough.
Reference: https://devrev.ai/docs/DevRevU/demos
